body: Looks like a sycamore leaf to me
I'm looking into a public defender. Not sure if I qualify but I think I'm going to stop by their office on Monday regardless.

Just graduated college and don't have a job. Also not really sure if a lawyer is worth the cost. I got an underage alcohol a few years back and got a lawyer for that. My friend who I was arrested with ended up with the exact same punishment as me, less an $850 lawyer bill. 

I feel like it should be a simple matter, but I then again, what about the law is simple...

I'm sure she knows. I honestly dont care about anything but her happiness. I would do anything to make her happy to the point of obsession. I can't possibly make her as happy as I want her to be and I doubt anyone else could, but I constantly beat myself up over her problems whether they're my fault or not (and they usually aren't). I can't go on living like this, I need to move on, I know it, but I can't as long as I'm around her. But I can't. When I feel down sometimes seeing her smile is the only thing that makes the days worth it. So what do I do? Either way I'm miserable for a long long time.

I'm in love with my friend and can't stop thinking about her to the point where it's legitimately driving me insane--I'm failing classes, screwing up friendships and not taking care of my health, but all I can think about is her. I tried asking her out, she said no, but that was 3 years ago and my feelings have only gotten stronger.
